name: users/migrations/__init__.py
summary: Package initializer for the users application's Django migrations module
purpose: Marks the migrations directory as a Python package, enabling Django's migration framework to discover, import, and execute database migration modules for the users app
responsibilities: Declare the migrations directory as a valid Python package
Enable Django's migration loader to identify and import migration modules
Serve as a namespace anchor for migration-related utilities if custom bases or helpers are provided
architecture_notes: Standard Python package marker required by Django's migration architecture. Django expects each app with models to contain a migrations package so the autodetector, loader, and executor can manage schema evolution. The file is typically empty but essential for Python's import system, sitting within the backend/apps/users/ module hierarchy following Django's co-location convention.
improvements: Add a module-level docstring clarifying the package role to reduce onboarding friction
Ensure the file is committed to version control so the migrations package exists in fresh clones
If custom migration base classes or shared utilities are used, centralize and document them here rather than scattering across individual migration files
